title: Wire the New World Spotlight layouts into the live Spotlight

source.ref: Theme readiness audit 2026-11-03: the six New World layouts (LIVE-2057) were drawn only on /themes/new-world

detail:
layouts.ts registers `new-world-kit:*`, the Spotlight shell draws them inside the same wrapper as the other kits, and the public Spotlight page loads New World's faces for them. The New World preset does not carry a default layout yet: the pin in components/spotlight/network-kit-layouts.test.tsx ('layouts none-for-others') needs the owner's own phrase before it can name new-world, so an owner reaches the layouts once that pin is rewritten.

Wired; the default-layout pin awaits the owner's phrase
